title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly expressed as E = 3mg/(4q) or an equivalent form.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve gravity and the electric force along the incline to establish the equilibrium condition for part (1).

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as a = 21g/20 or an equivalent form.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly apply Newton's second law along the incline using the new net force from gravity and the downward electric field.

title: Final speed expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly expressed as v = sqrt(7gH/2) or an equivalent form.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must correctly relate acceleration, displacement (H/sin37°), and final speed using an appropriate kinematic equation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if forces are resolved with incorrect signs or directions, especially for the electric force components on the incline.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates dimensional or unit consistency in the final expressions.
